1.consolidated_definition: Final, definitivo, no contingente. Sucede como resultado de una serie de hechos. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: sujeto a contingencia, incierto, provisional. Los funcionarios manifestaron que fueron citados por el Gran Jurado para explicar los pormenores de la contratación y eventual despido del ex ayudante especial de la JP, Jorge Velasco Mella, quien es investigado con relación al caso del Primer Ejecutivo
1.en_consolidated_definition: Final, definitive, non-contingent. Occurs as a result of a series of events. Semantic deviation, common. DRAE 2001: subject to contingency, uncertain, provisional. Officials stated that they were summoned by the Grand Jury to explain the details of the hiring and potential dismissal of former special assistant to the JP, Jorge Velasco Mella, who is being investigated in relation to the First Executive case
